closure_rule: DIST-G3 may close DIST-P100 only as REMEDIATED_AFTER_HISTORICAL_DEVIATION after DIST-R01 has committed through its two-phase candidate-install/promotion-rebind lifecycle; it must retain the historical deviation record and must not rewrite history as originally satisfied.
original_promise: Every DIST implementation overlay retains the before-commit editable-install refresh hook so subsequent overlays and gates exercise the transaction candidate Devtool rather than a stale installed CLI.

remediation_contract.artifact_validation: required native-Termux Devtool workflow before finalize/commit
remediation_contract.candidate_binding_proof: importlib.metadata direct_url.json must be editable and resolve exactly to the validation checkout root; under canonical apply-overlay that checkout is DEVTOOL_TRANSACTION_REPO_ROOT, while child tests need not receive the control environment variable
remediation_contract.metadata_restoration: devtool.egg-info is snapshotted/restored so the hook does not create undeclared repository writes
remediation_contract.network_policy: candidate install passes --no-index/--no-deps/--no-build-isolation and disables pip version checks; promotion rebind uses local editable source with --no-deps/--no-build-isolation under PIP_NO_INDEX=1 and PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
remediation_contract.promotion_rebind: before_commit hook resolves DEVTOOL_TRANSACTION_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT and re-points editable Devtool there before transaction integration/cleanup
